chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 566: The Hollow Aftermath — Grief and Strategy After Yu Wei's Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: The truth of Yu Wei's sacrifice sinks in. Daofather Crimsonbright tallies the defeat, Lü Dongbin mourns, and Ji Ning begins to pick up the pieces in a silence that cuts deeper than any blade.
og_title: The Hollow Aftermath — Yu Wei's Sacrifice Revealed
og_description: The truth of Yu Wei's sacrifice sinks in. Daofather Crimsonbright tallies the defeat, Lü Dongbin mourns, and Ji Ning begins to pick up the pieces in silence.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's hoarse reply lays bare the unhealable wound as the full cost of Yu Wei's betrayal echoes across the Crimsonbright camp.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
The second of the Three Sovereigns of Humanity; a figure of supreme power and wisdom who taught humanity agriculture and herbal medicine.
A world-altering alchemical item that immobilizes all Immortal ki within a vast area, turning immortal cultivators into mortals.
In Desolate Era cosmology, the complete scattering and extinguishing of the soul; the soul does not enter reincarnation and ceases to exist entirely.
A stone containing immense chaotic power, used as the energy core for Daofather Puppets.
The supreme Daofather of the Crimsonbright Realmverse, leader of the allied forces in the Realm War.
The three legendary human rulers Suiren, Fuxi, and the Divine Farmer, who guided humanity in ancient times.
